CLM-MAT-0007.statement: The extracted room-temperature thermal conductivity of the isotopically purified single-crystal diamond sample is approximately 3100 W m-1 K-1.

extra_quotes: The thermal conductivity (κ) of the sample was measured by TDTR.
However, despite the extremely low 13C content, the measured κ remains below the ~3500 W m-1 K-1 level expected for ideal 12C diamond based on Callaway model and first principle calculations.
